_meta.purpose: Reviewed web-researched Middle-earth lore names for career choice-group sub-paths (TAOM career screen revamp, Phase B).
_meta.format: <group_id>: { name, attested, note }. attested=true means the term/figure/place is canonical Tolkien lore; attested=false is an honest original coined in-keeping (or derived from a TAOM-original id).
_meta.sources: Per-faction research via tolkiengateway.net, lotr.fandom.com, encyclopedia-of-arda.com
